title: Twin Choice
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ling's unexpected choice made the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's hand suddenly tremble—that was not an omen, but a resonance. On the board of destiny, a piece never calculated had silently fallen.

text.content:
In the void, grayish-white light like solidified moonlight illuminated an infinite sea of consciousness with crystal clarity. Chen Ling floated in the center of this space, surrounded by silver spiritual patterns identical to Chen Ji's—those were the marks left by the Tianji Record Fragment within her. She looked down at her hands, fingertips trembling slightly. The words from that voice still echoed in her ears, each character burning her consciousness like a branding iron.

"Did you think the Tianji Record was something you obtained by chance? Everything was destined from the day you were born."

She lifted her head abruptly. All around her flowed silver streams of data, like countless delicate threads of fate interwoven into a net. And deep within this net, she saw a vague silhouette—with a face similar to hers, yet emanating a completely different aura.

She tried to step forward, only to find the ground beneath her feet was not solid earth, but a phantom made of countless points of light. With every step, tiny flickers of light scattered from beneath her feet, as if she were stepping on scattered stardust. The sensation was bizarre—strange yet familiar, as if she was meant to belong here.

A cold voice suddenly rang out from all directions simultaneously, devoid of any emotion:

"Dual consciousness detected. Fusion program locked. Confirm execution?"

Chen Ling shuddered throughout her body. Dual consciousness? Fusion program? Before she could make sense of these words, a blinding white light burst from her chest, searing her eyes shut. Through the gaps in her eyelids, she vaguely saw the silver data streams rushing toward her violently—that formation was clearly about to devour her completely!

dialogue.content: No... I don't want to be devoured!

text.content:
She struggled instinctively, waving her hands wildly through the air, only to grasp at nothingness. Those silver data streams coiled around her wrists, infiltrating her blood vessels along her skin, bringing waves of bone-piercing cold. Just as she thought she was about to be completely consumed, the white light in her chest suddenly contracted, repelling all the data streams.

Chen Ling knelt in the void, gasping for breath. Looking down, she discovered an imprint had appeared on her chest—she recognized that pattern; it was precisely the turtle shell pattern drawn on the Tianji Record Fragment. And beside this imprint, another slightly dimmer mark was faintly flickering, seemingly resonating with something within her body.

She suddenly realized, her pupils contracting sharply.

dialogue.content: This... this is his aura. He's also here? Brother—!

text.content:
She ran wildly toward the source of that aura, the silver space constantly collapsing and reorganizing behind her, as if this mental sea itself was changing with its master's will. Suddenly, a massive screen of light appeared ahead, and within it, a blurry scene was unfolding—a scene she had never seen before, yet inexplicably broke her heart.

In the scene, a teenage boy knelt in a torrential rain, drenched in blood, before a corpse that had already gone cold. The boy's lips moved, but no sound emerged—only rainwater sliding down his cheeks, impossible to tell rain or tears.

Chen Ling stopped in her tracks, staring blankly at this scene. She recognized that boy—it was Chen Ji, ten years ago. And that corpse...

Her breath stopped abruptly.

The corpse was wearing the attire of a Tianqing Sect Servant Disciple.

The screen flickered and the scene abruptly switched. This time, she saw another setting—a dark stone chamber, its four walls covered with dense arrays of talismans. An elderly man with white hair sat cross-legged in the chamber's center, eyes tightly closed, wrapped in countless silver threads. The other ends of those threads all connected to a young man standing opposite the elder.

That young man had delicate features, an aloof expression, and a faint smile at the corner of his lips—exactly Chen Ji.

The white-haired elder sighed, his voice aged and weary:

"Ji'er, I know you have great fortune, but the path you're walking requires a price far greater than you imagine. The Tianji Record chose you, yet it is also consuming you. Every time you peer into heavenly secrets, a fraction of your Heavenly Fate value drains away. When the Heavenly Fate is exhausted..."

Chen Ji coolly interrupted the elder:

"Master, you needn't say more. My decision is made."

The scene froze at this point, then slowly dissolved.

Chen Ling stood where she was, speechless for a long while. Heavenly Fate value, peering into heavenly secrets, the price... these words collided endlessly in her mind, piecing together a picture she had never imagined. So the burden her brother had carried all these years was far more than she could ever know.

She had thought being taken away by the Holy Sect was the greatest misfortune, but only now did she understand—the one truly walking alone in the darkness had always been the brother she thought had long forgotten her.

Just then, the surrounding silver data streams suddenly fluctuated violently, and a familiar voice pierced through the layers of mist, directly entering her consciousness:

"Xiao Ling, is that you?"

That voice was hoarse and weary, carrying a warmth Chen Ling could hardly believe. For ten years, she had heard this voice countless times in dreams, yet never imagined she would one day hear it so clearly calling her name.

dialogue.content: Bro... Brother! Is that you? Where are you?

text.content:
She ran wildly toward the direction of the voice, the silver data streams constantly parting and reuniting around her, as if making way for her. Passing through layers upon layers of light screens, she finally saw the owner of that voice—

Chen Ji stood in the void not far away, wrapped in dozens of silver light chains, the other ends of those chains deeply embedded in the void beneath his feet. His face was pale as paper, his brow creased with heavy weariness, yet he still stood with his spine straight, as if bearing an invisible mountain.

At the moment she saw him, he saw her too.

In those eyes that had always been calm as an ancient well, a rare ripple appeared.

dialogue.content: Xiao Ling, you shouldn't be here.

text.content:
Chen Ling rushed forward, but was stopped three feet from Chen Ji by an invisible barrier. She beat desperately against that barrier, tears uncontrollably streaming down:

"Brother! I searched for you for ten years! Ten years! Do you know how much I missed you!"

Her voice echoed through the vast mental space, unable to hide its sobbing tone. All those convictions that had sustained her through those dark days in the Holy Sect's dungeons had now become weight pressing down on this stubborn figure before her.

Yet Chen Ji only looked at her quietly, his gaze complex beyond interpretation. After a long silence, he softly said:

"I know. But you shouldn't have been dragged into this. The Tianji Record chose you as a lock-key, not as a blessing, but as a shackle. I spent ten years setting up this scheme, precisely to remove this shackle from you..."

He paused, then suddenly drew a bitter smile:

"But I never expected you would come looking on your own."

dialogue.content: I'm not leaving! Since I found you, I'll never leave again!

text.content:
Her voice was resolute, brooking no argument. Chen Ji looked at her, a subtle hint of emotion flickering in his eyes, yet quickly covered by heavy worry.

"Silly girl, you don't understand." He shook his head, his voice low, "The place you're in now is the core of my mental sea. The Tianji Record's fusion program has already started. If you stay here, you will be forcibly fused with me—not as a sister, but as part of my soul. You will lose all memories, lose your independent personality, and become another me."

Chen Ling shuddered.

"But what if I leave?" she asked.

Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then said: "If you choose to leave, I will try my best to sever your connection with the Tianji Record. You will become a completely independent individual, no longer bound by the Tianji Record—but you also will no longer be able to sense me, nor use any power related to the Tianji Record. And I..."

He didn't continue, but Chen Ling had already read the fleeting desolation in his eyes. If she left, he would face the Tianji Record's backlash alone, bear all the costs of peering into heavenly secrets alone.

Just then, the surrounding silver data streams fluctuated violently again, and a cold mental prompt sounded simultaneously in both their minds:

"Dual consciousness fusion program has entered irreversible stage. Remaining decision time: one hour. Countdown begins."

In the void, a massive hourglass materialized, golden sands一粒粒 falling down, each grain representing the precious little time Chen Ling had left.

Chen Ji looked at Chen Ling, his eyes revealing for the first time a near-pleading expression:

"Xiao Ling, listen to me. Choose the third path, leave this place."

Yet Chen Ling smiled, that smile carrying tears yet brilliant beyond measure:

"Brother, do you know? Back in the Holy Sect's dungeon, I thought countless times—if I could just see you one more time, even dying immediately would be worth it."

She reached out and touched that invisible barrier, her fingertips carrying warmth:

"Now I've finally found you. What do you think I would choose?"

Chen Ji's expression changed completely. He stepped forward violently, both hands pressed against the barrier, his knuckles white from force:

"Listen to me! I spent ten years planning this, all to set you free! You can't give this all up for me!"

But Chen Ling only gently shook her head, tears sliding down her cheeks and falling onto the invisible barrier, stirring tiny ripples:

"Brother, you're wrong."

Her voice was gentle yet firm, like that small back figure from ten years ago when she left, stubborn enough to break hearts:

"These ten years, I was searching for you too. Not because of weakness, not because of dependence. Because you're my brother, because in this world, I only want to stand by your side."

She took a deep breath, and the silver data streams slowly gathered behind her, outlining a pair of illusory wings:

"So this time, it's my turn to choose."

choice.prompt: Chen Ling made a choice that shocked everyone—

choices.description: Chen Ling chose to fuse with Chen Ji at the soul level, neither abandoning her independent consciousness nor leaving this space. She would share the burden of the Tianji Record together with him.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the 'Twin Resonance' ability—share perception with Chen Ji, reducing Heavenly Fate consumption by 30%.
choices.risk_hint: The fusion process is filled with unknowns, possibly leading to consciousness disorder.

text.content: Silver light burst from Chen Ling's chest, echoing with the silver chains around Chen Ji. The two consciousnesses intersected in the void, like two rivers long separated finally converging. Pain and warmth came simultaneously. Chen Ling felt her brother's memories flood into her mind like a tide—those lonely nights, those moments of gritting teeth and persisting, those years of walking alone in the darkness... all became part of her.

When the light faded, Chen Ling found the barrier between her and Chen Ji had vanished. She could clearly perceive his heartbeat, his breathing, his churning emotions—a connection unprecedented, deeper than any blood tie. Chen Ji stared at her, lips slightly trembling, as if countless words were stuck in his throat, ultimately only turning into a soft sigh: 'Silly girl...'

choices.description: Chen Ling chooses to sever her connection with the Tianji Record, leaving the mental space as an independent individual. She will face the outside world alone, guarding the peace behind her brother.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the soul connection with Chen Ji
choices.visible_reward: Become a completely independent individual, no longer bound by the Tianji Record, can secretly accumulate power in the outside world
choices.risk_hint: Numerous dangers lurk outside, independent action carries extremely high risk

text.content: Chen Ling slowly stepped back, silver data streams began to drain from her body, taking away the turtle shell mark and the final connection between her and the Tianji Record. The process of detachment was not painful, but left her with an unprecedented sense of loss—that was the feeling of the invisible bond with her brother being cut apart.

Chen Ji stood in place, watching her figure gradually become transparent. He did not stop her, because he knew this was her own choice. After a long while, Chen Ling turned her head and gave him a relieved smile: 'Brother, I'll be waiting for you outside. This time, let me watch this world for you.' The words fell, her figure dissolved like morning mist in the void, leaving only a faint fragrance to prove she had been there.

choices.description: Chen Ling chooses to temporarily slumber within Chen Ji, preserving her strength in a third form, to awaken when the time is ripe. This is a compromise—neither permanent fusion nor complete separation.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the 'Dormancy' state—accumulate power within Chen Ji, can awaken to assist at critical moments, Heavenly Fate consumption reduced by 15%
choices.risk_hint: During slumber, cannot act independently, completely dependent on Chen Ji's judgment

text.content: Chen Ling did not choose fusion, nor did she choose to leave. She raised her hand, gently pressing the turtle shell mark between her brows. Silver light flowed from her fingertips, weaving an ethereal rainbow bridge between the two: 'Brother, I choose the third path.' Her voice was calm and firm, carrying a maturity beyond her years: 'Let me slumber deep within your consciousness. This way I can preserve my independent consciousness while helping you when you need it.'

Chen Ji was stunned. He had thought she would choose fusion, had thought she would choose to leave, but never imagined she would propose such a plan. This third path preserved her independence while giving him the support he needed most—when did this girl become so calculating? Yet what moved him more was that she chose to trust him, willing to place part of her fate in his hands. 'Alright.' He whispered his agreement, voice slightly trembling. Silver light wrapped around Chen Ling, her figure gradually becoming transparent, finally transforming into a streak of light that entered Chen Ji's brow center. Before she disappeared completely, her voice rang in his mind, carrying a hint of playfulness: 'Brother, remember what you promised. I'm watching you inside. Don't do anything foolish.'

The mental space slowly dissipated. Chen Ji suddenly opened his eyes to find himself still sitting cross-legged before the Tianji Record Fragment. The turtle shell in his hand was slightly warm, its patterns even more intricate than before—the mark Chen Ling had left. He lowered his head, looking at his palm, feeling that faint warmth within his body. That was his sister's presence, unseen for ten years, now returned to his side in such a strange way. Outside the window, dawn had begun to break. Another endless night had passed, and on the chessboard of fate, a new variable had been added. Chen Ji stood up, storing the Tianji Record Fragment in his chest, a faint smile curving his lips: 'Xiao Ling, you silly girl...' His voice carried helplessness, yet hid deep heartache and relief. In this game, he originally wanted to completely remove his sister from the chessboard, never expecting her to force her way back, insisting on sharing this fate with him. But that's fine too.

He pushed open the door, the morning's cold air rushing toward him. Above the peaks of Tianqing Sect, clouds surged like tides. The distant sun was slowly rising from behind the clouds, dyeing the horizon a magnificent gold and crimson. Just then, a sharp sword aura attacked from the side! Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly, his body remained motionless as the sword aura brushed past his ear, leaving a three-inch-deep sword mark on the stone wall behind him. He didn't even lift his eyelids, simply speaking calmly: 'Junior Sister Su, so early for sword practice?' Su Qingyao emerged from the mist, her sword still unsheathed, thin frost coating the blade. Her gaze was like a blade, fixed tightly on Chen Ji's face, seemingly wanting to find some flaw in his expression: 'Last night at midnight, there was unusual activity in your room. I came to confirm whether you're still alive.' Her tone was cold, but Chen Ji caught a subtle hint of worry hidden in her eyes. This woman, always so contradictory in her words. He slightly tilted his head, meeting her gaze with a harmless smile: 'Thanks for your concern, Senior Sister. Your disciple is perfectly well.'

Su Qingyao's brow furrowed slightly. She stared at Chen Ji for a long time, trying to find even a trace of flaw on that calm face, but the youth before her remained as she knew him—timid, honest, harmless. But she always felt something was off. 'Your aura...' she suddenly spoke, her voice carrying confusion, 'is stronger than yesterday.' Chen Ji's heart tightened imperceptibly, yet his expression remained unchanged: 'Perhaps last night's meditation led to slight progress. Forgive my boldness, Senior Sister.' Su Qingyao gave him a deep look, and ultimately did not press further. She put away her sword and turned to leave, only leaving behind a casual remark: 'In three days, the Inner Sect Tournament. Everyone must attend. You... take care.' Her figure soon vanished in the mist. Chen Ji stood alone at the cliff edge, feeling the morning's cold wind brush his face. In his mind, Chen Ling's voice suddenly rang out with a hint of teasing: 'Brother, this Senior Sister seems quite concerned about you.' Chen Ji's mouth twitched slightly: 'Quiet, go rest.'

The Tianji Record Fragment in his chest grew slightly warm. Chen Ji lowered his head to look and found more lines of text had appeared on it—content added after Chen Ling's choice: 'The twin bond is established, the chess game shifts again. Internal bonds exist, external strong enemies surround. The tournament in three days is crisis, yet also opportunity.' He silently memorized these words, then stored the fragment carefully. In three days, the Inner Sect Tournament would see disciples from all three major sects present. Ling Yuan the old sect master, Han Lie, and those hidden forces... everyone was waiting to watch his joke, waiting to see thistrash disciple丢人现眼 before the public. But they didn't know that within these three days, he had already laid down three backup plans. And now, he had one more card no势力 had ever known about. Chen Ji raised his head, gazing at the distant surging clouds, his eyes flashing a sharp light: 'Come on, let me show you what it means to扮猪吃虎.' His voice was not loud, yet carried an unsettling certainty. The wheels of fate turned once more, and this game of chess would be more spectacular than any before.
